Container.Name: Whisper-asr
Container.Overview: GPU-accelerated Whisper ASR Webservice: speech-to-text over a simple HTTP API (transcribe or translate audio/video, with word-level timestamps; output as txt, srt, vtt, tsv or json). Uses the official onerahmet image unchanged, so it updates normally with the Docker "Update" button. Models are stored on the host (Models path below), not inside the docker image.[br][br][b]Upgrading from an older version of this template:[/b] if your container has two "SubSyncarr patch" paths (Edit container, Show more settings), clear both of them and click Apply. Older versions of this template filled them in, and they stop the container from starting after an image update.
Container.Changes: ### 2026.11.25 - Standalone: removed the two "SubSyncarr patch" file mappings. The container now runs the official image as-is, so image updates can no longer break it. - If you installed an older version: Edit the container, clear the two "SubSyncarr patch" paths (Show more settings), and click Apply. Your settings and downloaded models are kept. - Added the new optional settings from Whisper ASR Webservice 1.11: API_KEY, ASR_VAD_FILTER, LOG_LEVEL. - Models path default is now /mnt/user/appdata/whisper-asr.
Container.Requires: Requires the unRAID "Nvidia Driver" plugin and an NVIDIA GPU. First start downloads the model (large-v3 is about 3 GB) to the Models path below. On a 6 GB card keep ASR_QUANTIZATION=int8. (No NVIDIA GPU? Use the CPU-only template instead.)

Config.Name: ASR_ENGINE
Config.Description: Engine: faster_whisper (recommended: fastest, lowest VRAM), openai_whisper, or whisperx.

Config.Name: ASR_MODEL
Config.Description: Model: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3. Larger = more accurate + more VRAM.

Config.Name: ASR_QUANTIZATION
Config.Description: Model precision: float32, float16, int8. On GPU this DEFAULTS to float32 (huge). Use int8 so large-v3 fits in ~2.5 GB VRAM (needed for 6 GB cards like a GTX 1660 Ti); use float16 on bigger cards for max accuracy.

Config.Name: ASR_MODEL_PATH
Config.Description: Where models are stored INSIDE the container. Must match the Models host-path mapping below so models persist on disk instead of bloating the docker image.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Host folder that persists downloaded models. Keeps the model OUT of the docker image.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU(s) to expose. 'all', or a specific GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin.

Config.Name: MODEL_IDLE_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds of inactivity before the model is unloaded from VRAM (0 = keep loaded). Set e.g. 300 to free the GPU between jobs at the cost of a reload delay.

Config.Name: ASR_VAD_FILTER
Config.Description: true = skip silent parts of the audio by default (voice activity detection, faster_whisper only). Each request can still override it.

Config.Name: API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. When set, every request must send this key in the X-API-Key header. Leave empty for no key.
